name: Auth0 Token Vault
description: Stores and refreshes users' OAuth tokens for Google, Slack, GitHub and more so AI agents can call third-party APIs on their behalf. Part of Auth0 for AI Agents by Okta.

skills.name: Vault Users' OAuth Tokens
skills.description: Stores and refreshes each user's access and refresh tokens for connected accounts like Google, Microsoft, Slack and GitHub.

skills.name: Call APIs on a User's Behalf
skills.description: Exchanges an Auth0 token for a provider access token so an agent can call external APIs as the signed-in user.

skills.name: Ask Users to Approve Actions
skills.description: Requests user consent for sensitive agent actions by push notification, SMS or email using CIBA asynchronous authorization.

skills.name: Authorize RAG Retrieval
skills.description: Filters the documents an agent retrieves with Auth0 Fine-Grained Authorization so answers only use data the user may see.
